notes.title: PRESS RELEASE for Till the dawn, waiting
notes.notes:
Hey Fellas, 

The game is set to release on 12th Jan 2018 and the word is already out about the game. We have taken the press kit LIVE for people to know and write more about the game!

Link: http://underdogsthestudio.com/TTDW/presskit.html

Download the kit: https://www.dropbox.com/s/rye2k3ieja3o3ly/PressKit_TTDW.zip?dl=0
